title: The equivalence compares block-count (blocks.filter(isResolved).length) against…
description:
The equivalence compares block-count (blocks.filter(isResolved).length) against marker-occurrence-count (rawMarkerMatches.length). These diverge if a single bullet block ever carried two [resolved YYYY-MM] markers. Both are 0 in the real file today, so the test passes correctly; consider comparing against the count of blocks containing >=1 marker (or documenting the one-marker-per-bullet assumption) to keep the cross-check robust under format drift.
